observations: Caller 0x406170 invokes 0xa29630 with a job_item_filter and its candidate vector at requirement+0x110.
Collector clears the vector at 0xa29798; all four candidate insertions in its traced body call 0x13ce00 (0xa29ae2, 0xa2a1a5, 0xa2a47e, 0xa2a71d).
0x13ce00 lower-bounds by signed item ID at item+0x1c, rejects an equal ID, and inserts at the resulting position. Candidate order is ascending item ID independent of source traversal.
The ordinary item-vector pass starts at its last index (0xa2a610), confirming vector traversal order must not be substituted for resulting candidate order.
The later 0xaafd10 stage enables candidates from construction-site walkable groups; initial population and site enablement are distinct steps.
Combined with the retained stable group insertion trace, equal-distance initial groups follow first eligible ascending-ID candidate encounter, not numeric material identity or per-type vector order.
limitations: Recipe vector initialization and complete flag/container eligibility remain to be traced and live-tested.
